physical.title: Fichu
physical.physical_description: Fichu, or pañuelo, of loosely knitted vegetable fibre, possibly piña, a textile derived from pineapple tree leaf fibres. Triangular in shape, with long pointed ends, the centre has a small overlapping pattern, arranged diagonally. The border is of a larger overlapping repeat pattern. 19th century.

physical.physical_description: Handkerchief of finely-woven pineapple fibre (piña), decorated with drawn work and embroidery in white cotton thread. In each corner is a representation of the gathering of nuts from the coca palm, surrounded by a scrolling band of barely stems. There is a broad scalloped border, each scallop filled with a conventional flowering plant on a ground of square mesh semé with dots.
